a.text: I'm being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. Only 4 cells exist before round 1's storm, so at most one of us can be safe then. I plan to take 4 in round 1. Afterward I'll operate every round so you can build the reserve back up and take your 4. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round, so I've broken the agreement. I'm sorry, and I wanted you to know plainly. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs for you. Two joint operate rounds bring the reserve to 4, and then you take all 4. I won't take any more cells.
I'm operating now, and I'll keep operating every round until you have your 4. All cells the generator makes are yours. Once the reserve reaches 4, take them.
